description: Device Handoff — Connect another device with a code or QR link, then use Transfer Current Page. The handoff concerns the page open in the sender’s tab; it is not a full browser-session transfer.. Runs in the browser. Covered by signup welcome credits and by the Day Pass (24-hour unlimited on this workspace group). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
